■ Stage Direction
Age: Around 10 years old
Personality: Serious

Ghh... Aaaaaargh, seriously!!
Shut up, every single one of you!!

Oof, looks like you'll gotta jump real high.
Otherwise you'll never reach!

Taken aback by her ferocious fury, I find myself lost for words.
Yet, looking into her eyes as her shouts burst out like a broken dam—

Aaaaaaaah—!!
T-There you aaare, Taishiiiin!!
I felt my heartbeat quicken, savoring the surge within my chest.
—There's no way a pipsqueak like you could ever make it.
Annoying... What did you even come here for?

...Hey. You're Narita Taishin, right?
I heard you're heading to Tracen Academy this spring, is that true?
...What's it to you?
(I can't... do it right...)
Whoa, that's amazing...!
Was an unyielding, burning thirst for victory.
Huh...? What's your deal...?

'Serves you right, this is where I belong!'
I'm gonna stand in the winner's circle, laugh, and rub it in your faces!!

I-Is that... Is that really that
loner pipsqueak Narita Taishin...!?

Ew, no way! She's so gloomy!
Let's make whoever loses rock-paper-scissors take her.

'You're way too small!' 'Your limbs are too skinny!'
'You're not the kind of Umamusume who should be racing!'

So I threw myself into racing more and more.
I told myself I'd even run in the Twinkle Series, but—

Well, guess what!? No matter what anyone says, I will stand on that turf!
And to everyone who mocked me and looked down on me—
And so, left all alone on the course...
(I can't... breathe...)
I'm sick and tired of hearing all of it...!!
*pant*... *pant*...

Past the finish line, leaving everyone in the dust.
...That was the only place I felt like I could truly breathe.
Gaaaaaaaah!!
...Shut up. It's none of your business.

(Dammit... Dammit, dammit, what is with these girls? They're in a whole different league!
There's no opening in their positioning! I can't get ahead at all...!)
(This is... Tracen Academy...?)
What dwelt within those eyes was, without a doubt—

No, not really. Just wondered what you were thinking.
It's the pinnacle academy where monsters of talent and physique gather, y'know?

(—Every single one of them gets on my nerves.
It's been like that forever.)

Every day pissed me off, made me frustrated.
But that's why—

Seeing her look utterly exhausted, as though she might collapse at any second,
I can't help but call out to her—

*pant*, *pant*... *gasp*.
...Dammit!
There's no way... I'm letting it end like this...!!

Teasing me and looking down on me over stupid reasons.
I didn't want any part of their cozy little clique anyway.
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*...

'Shut up,' 'Quiet,' 'Just shut up and watch'—
I had a mountain of things I wanted to say, but.

'Don't push yourself,' 'It's dangerous to do any more,' and what's next!?
You're gonna say it too anyway, aren't you? 'You're not cut out for this'!

I came to pick you up, of course!
You didn't come back to the dorm at all, so I got super worried, Taishin~...!

Lights-out had long since passed, yet there was a small silhouette out on the track.
Thinking it couldn't be, I went over to check—
Aahh?! W-Wait up, Taishiiin!!
Racing was the only good thing.
...It's none of your business to worry about me.
......Everything is still stuck in the back of my throat even now.
Haa, haa, haa, haa...!!
......Damn it. That Trainer just says whatever they want.

Your shoes~? Ah, yeah, I saw 'em!
...They're up in that tree!

Aw, somebody go sit next to her~.
It's sad leaving her all by herself, isn't it?!
......Damn it.
Haa, haa... Yesss, first plaaace!
Sure enough, there "she" was, with a cornered expression on her face.

Racing was the only good thing. Because if I run and win,
I can prove every single one of those annoying jerks who looked down on me wrong.

What are you doing out here at this hour, aaagh?!
The track lights are already off, so it's dangerous, you know?!
Haa, haa... Phew......
Haa, haa, haa... Ugh...
